title: Funds from a Non-Medicaid Resident Funds Account Applied to a Pending-Month Advance
content:
**Clause.** Under Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage, the funds subtracted from an advance toward a coming pending month, read from the resident's funds account: where the account is a non-Medicaid self-directed or guardianship account carrying a standing authorization for Medicaid patient pay and a pension was deposited into it within the last two months, the latest pension deposit; where the account is a non-Medicaid representative payee account and a Social Security benefit was received as payee within the last two months, the latest benefit received less the personal needs allowance, never below zero, which the payee leaves for the resident's personal needs; otherwise nothing. These funds are subtracted after the estimate's floor at zero.

The resident's funds account is the resident's account in status active under Resident Trust Fund Accounts; its tier and standing authorization are on the account, and the deposits are its pension direct deposits and Social Security benefits received as payee. The personal needs allowance is 45.00 dollars a month. Where two deposits share the latest date, the one posted first is the latest.

**Cases (hypothetical).**

| Account tier | Condition | Funds subtracted |
|---|---|---|
| Non-Medicaid Self-Directed or Non-Medicaid Guardianship | standing authorization for Medicaid patient pay, latest pension 655.25 within two months | 655.25 |
| Non-Medicaid Self-Directed or Non-Medicaid Guardianship | no such authorization | nothing |
| Non-Medicaid Representative Payee | latest benefit 1,093.00 received as payee within two months | 1,093.00 less 45.00, which is 1,048.00 |
| Non-Medicaid Representative Payee | latest benefit 38.00 received as payee within two months | nothing (38.00 less 45.00 is below zero) |
| any of these | no qualifying deposit within the last two months | nothing |
| any Medicaid tier | any | nothing |
